title: Spinach, Fetta & Ricotta Stuffed Capsicums
subtitle: with Chat Potatoes & Balsamic Cucumber Salad
description: Stuffed capsicums are back on the menu and tonight's ones take a veggie-loaded ricotta filling, a crumbling of fetta and a panko crumb and roast up to golden perfection in the oven. This one will quickly become a household regular!

steps.text:
•

• Preheat oven to 240°C/220°C fan-forced.
• Slice capsicum in half lengthways, then remove 
stem and seeds. 
• Halve chat potatoes.
• Place capsicums on a lined oven tray. Brush with 
olive oil and season with salt and pepper. Arrange 
cut-side up and roast until tender, 15-20 minutes.
• Meanwhile, place potatoes on a second lined oven 
tray. Drizzle with olive oil, season with salt and 
pepper and toss to coat. Roast until tender,  
25-30 minutes.

•

• While the potatoes are roasting, thinly slice  
brown onion. 
• Finely chop garlic. 
• Roughly chop baby spinach leaves. 
• Slice lemon into wedges.
• In a small bowl, combine panko breadcrumbs 
(see ingredients) and a drizzle of olive oil. Season 
with salt and pepper.

•

• In a large frying pan, heat a drizzle of olive oil 
over medium-high heat. Cook onion and baby 
spinach leaves, stirring, until wilted and softened,  
4-5 minutes.
• Add garlic and cook until fragrant, 1 minute. 
Transfer to a large bowl and set aside to cool 
slightly.
• When capsicums have 5 minutes remaining, to  
the bowl with spinach, add ricotta, a good squeeze 
of lemon juice and a generous pinch of salt 
and pepper, then crumble in smooth fetta  
(see ingredients). Gently mix until combined.

•

• Remove tray with roasted capsicums from oven 
and spoon filling into capsicums.
• Top with panko crumb, then bake until golden 
brown, 5-10 minutes.

•

• While the capsicums are baking, thinly slice 
cucumber into half-moons.
• In a medium bowl, combine cucumber,  
spinach & rocket mix and balsamic vinaigrette 
dressing. Season with salt and pepper.

•

• Divide spinach, fetta and ricotta stuffed capsicums, 
chat potatoes and balsamic cucumber salad 
between plates to serve. Enjoy!
